text: The diagram shows the part of the curve y = tan 2x for 0 ≤ x ≤ π. Find the x-coordinates of the
points on this part of the curve at which the gradient is 4. [5]
4 Solve the equation 3 − 7(3 ) + 10 = 0, giving your answers correct to 3 significant figures. [5]
5 The polynomial 4x + ax + 9x + 9, where a is a constant, is denoted by p(x). It is given that when
p(x) is divided by (2x − 1) the remainder is 10.
